title: Your Company's Digital Brain: Internal AI Trained on Your Own Data
body:
Do you know how much money you lose a year because your employees interrupt each other to ask where a document is or how a process is done?

Knowledge management is the great black hole of modern businesses. You have operation manuals in Drive, HR policies in a PDF, vacation rules on the intranet... When an employee has a question, they do one of two things: waste 20 minutes searching fruitlessly, or interrupt a colleague or manager on Slack to ask. That chain of interruptions destroys the entire team's productivity.

The Problem with Public ChatGPT or Traditional Search

Many companies encourage employees to use ChatGPT, but public AI doesn't know what time your warehouse opens or what your refund policy is. And if they upload private documents, they expose confidential company data to the world. On the other hand, traditional intranet search bars are stupid: if you don't type the exact keyword, they find nothing.

Our Solution: Secure and Private RAG Architecture

At LANZAESTUDIO.ES we build your own internal cognitive assistant. We use the most advanced Artificial Intelligence technology (RAG) but in a closed, secure environment just for your company.

  1. Data Ingestion: We connect the AI to your Google Drive, Notion, or PDF database. The AI reads and understands all your company's manuals.
  2. Semantic Search: An employee asks 'How many paternity leave days do I get?' in their own words, and the AI doesn't look for a keyword; it understands the concept.
  3. Instant Answers with Sources: In 3 seconds, the AI gives them the exact answer and, most importantly, adds a link to the original document so they can verify it.
  4. Absolute Privacy: Your data is never used to train public models. It stays on your servers.

The Real Impact on Your Operations

  • Eliminate Bottlenecks: Department heads stop answering the same 15 basic questions every single day.
  • Immediate Onboarding: New hires get a 24/7 assistant to answer their initial questions without feeling like they are bothering their peers.
  • Massive ROI: Saving just 30 minutes a day per employee justifies the cost of the system in the first month of use.
